name: Basic User (Single Service)
query: query GetUser($id: ID!) { user(id: $id) { id name } }

name: User with Posts (Federation Extension)
query: query UserWithPosts($id: ID!) { user(id: $id) { id name posts { id title } } }

name: Post with Author Reference
query: query GetPost($id: ID!) { user(id: $id) { posts { id title author { id name } } } }

name: Post with Comments (Multi-Service Chain)
query: query PostWithComments($userId: ID!) { user(id: $userId) { posts { id title comments { id body author { id name } } } } }

name: Typename Check (Cross-Service Metadata)
query: query TypenameCheck($id: ID!) { user(id: $id) { __typename id name posts { __typename id title comments { __typename body } } } }

name: Federation Feature: Fragment Spread
description: Verify fragment spread support with named fragments
query: query { user(id: "user1") { ...UserFields } } fragment UserFields on User { id name posts { id title } }

name: Federation Feature: Inline Fragments
query: query { user(id: "user1") { id ... on User { name posts { id title } } } }

name: Federation Feature: Nested Fragments
description: Verify nested fragment expansion (fragments referencing other fragments)
query: query { user(id: "user1") { ...UserWithPosts } } fragment UserWithPosts on User { ...BasicUser posts { ...PostInfo } } fragment BasicUser on User { id name } fragment PostInfo on Post { id title }

name: Federation v2: @requires - Engagement Score Computation
description: Verify that @requires automatically fetches likeCount field for engagementScore calculation
query: query { user(id: "user1") { posts { id title engagementScore } } }

name: Federation v2: @inaccessible - Should block access to email
description: Verify that @inaccessible field cannot be queried
query: query { user(id: "user1") { id name email } }

name: Federation v2: @tag - Fields with tags should work normally
description: Verify that @tag fields can be queried (tags are metadata)
query: query { user(id: "user1") { id name } }

name: Variables: Multiple Variables Query
description: Verify handling of queries with multiple variables using aliases
query: query MultiVars($userId1: ID!, $userId2: ID!) { user1: user(id: $userId1) { id name } user2: user(id: $userId2) { id name } }

name: Variables: Optional Variable Override
description: Verify variables work correctly with different values
query: query UserWithDefault($id: ID!) { user(id: $id) { id name } }

name: Variables: Complex Nested Query with Variables
description: Verify variables work in complex nested federation queries
query: query UserPostsCommentsVar($uid: ID!) { user(id: $uid) { id name posts { id title comments { id body author { name } } } } }

name: Federation v2: @interfaceObject - Content Feed
description: Verify @interfaceObject support for Content interface via feed query
query: query { feed(userId: "user1") { id body } }

feed.body: Hello from the feed! This is the first post.

name: Federation v2: @override - Post Moderation Status Override
description: Verify @override directive overrides post moderation fields
query: query { user(id: "user1") { posts { id title moderationStatus } } }

name: Federation v2: @override - Comment Moderation Override
description: Verify @override applies to comments moderation as well
query: query { user(id: "user1") { posts { id comments { id body moderationStatus } } } }

name: Federation v2: Union - Notifications with LikeNotification
description: Verify union type resolution for like interaction notifications
query: query { notifications(userId: "user1") { ... on LikeNotification { id post { id } likedBy { id } } } }

name: Federation v2: Union - Notifications with CommentNotification
description: Verify union type resolution for comment interaction notifications
query: query { notifications(userId: "user1") { ... on CommentNotification { id comment { id } } } }

name: Federation v2: @provides - Comment with Author Name
description: Verify @provides directive resolves author name from parent context
query: query { user(id: "user1") { posts { id comments { id body author { id name } } } } }

name: Multi-Service Query with Aliases
description: Verify querying multiple users with aliases in one query
query: query { u1: user(id: "user1") { id name } u2: user(id: "user2") { id name } }
